meaning:
Group of ge.shur (גְּשׁוּר "Geshur" H1650)
§ Geshuri or Geshurites
1) inhabitants of Geshur
2) a tribe in south Palestine of or near the Philistines

elsewhere.note: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name…
and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of…
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land, who were of old, on the way…
